    • resetResourcesQuantity

      public void resetResourcesQuantity(Map<ItemColor,Integer> availableResources)
      Resets the quantities of resources available in the resource bank based on the specified map of resources. Useful to recreate the ClientModel information after a client reconnection
      Parameters:
      availableResources - a map where the key is an ItemColor representing the resource color and the value is an Integer representing the available quantity for that color.

    • addResourceToPlayerFromBank

      public ResourceBank addResourceToPlayerFromBank(Player player, ItemColor color, int i, int j) throws IllegalStateException, NoSuchElementException
      Transfers a resource of a specified color from the resource bank to a player's storage, provided the storage is valid, has enough space, and the player is not eliminated. Ensures that RED resources can only be stored in special storage components. The operation is performed only if the resource bank has at least one resource of the specified color available.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player receiving the resource.
      color - the ItemColor of the resource to be transferred.
      i - the row index of the target storage component on the player's ship.
      j - the column index of the target storage component on the player's ship.
      Returns:
      the ResourceBank instance after the operation is executed.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the specified storage component is invalid, has no more space, or cannot store RED resources.
      NoSuchElementException - if the resource bank does not have the specified resource.

    • addResourceToBankFromPlayer

      public ResourceBank addResourceToBankFromPlayer(Player player, ItemColor color, int i, int j) throws IllegalStateException, NoSuchElementException
      Transfers a resource of a specified color from a player's storage component to the resource bank. Validates whether the specified storage component exists and has an item of the provided color. The operation is performed only if the player is not eliminated.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player whose resource is to be transferred to the bank.
      color - the ItemColor representing the color of the resource to be transferred.
      i - the row index of the storage component on the player's ship.
      j - the column index of the storage component on the player's ship.
      Returns:
      the ResourceBank instance after the operation is executed.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the specified storage component at indices i, j is invalid.
      NoSuchElementException - if there is no resource of the specified ItemColor in the selected storage.
